svg.text: 1. FABRICATE, INSPECT AND TEST PER IPC/WHMA-A-620, CLASS 2.
2. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MM. LENGTHS ARE MEASURED FROM CONNECTOR REAR FACE TO BREAKOUT CENTRE OR TO THE NEXT CONNECTOR REAR FACE.
3. LENGTH TOLERANCES UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: over: ±3. SEGMENT DIMENSIONS GOVERN; OVERALL DIMENSIONS ARE REFERENCE.
4. DRAWING NOT TO SCALE. WIRE CUT LENGTHS PER WIRE LIST; CONNECTIONS PER CONNECTOR TABLES AND WIRING DIAGRAM.
5. THE 3D ROUTE IS SHOWN FLATTENED, AS LAID ON THE FORMBOARD; SEE THE 3D VIEW FOR ITS SHAPE IN PLACE.
6. CONTINUITY-TEST 100% AGAINST THE WIRE LIST; NO SHORTS BETWEEN NETS.
7. DERIVED FROM LULZBOT DRAWING EL-HR0091 REV A (ALEPH OBJECTS, INC., CC BY-SA 4.0).
8. BARE SHIELD WIRE OF EACH CABLE TO P1 PINS 5, 10 AND 15; TRIM THE SHIELD AT THE MOTOR END.
9. BRAIDED SLEEVING OVER EACH CABLE, ENDING 10 MM SHORT OF EACH CABLE END.
